data.name: Harmeet
data.long_meaning: Har means 'God' and Meet means 'nectar'. This name is derived from the Hindu mythology where the Gods and Demons churned the ocean to obtain Amrit, the elixir of immortality. Harmeet refers to the nectar obtained from this process.
